data.scope: Same exact task/reference/input-generator source; new case configuration only.

primary_criteria.screen: Same immutable per-task .02 quality allowance, nondecreasing aggregate quality per repeat, <=5% wall/solver overhead and original quality/cost benefit gates; complete independent full results.
primary_criteria.practical: Additionally >=10% relative quality gain with <=5% wall and token overhead, or >=10% wall saving at protected quality with <=5% token overhead. Both repeats protected; failed/incomplete usage prevents acceptance.
primary_criteria.uncertainty: Exhaustive paired bootstrap over4operator clusters (256 ordered resamples); each includes bothcase sets and bothrepeats. Six exploratory outcome/reference comparisons, one-sided alpha .05/6. Do not pretend8case sets are independent operators.
primary_criteria.cost: All acquisition/failed development costs retained; explicit incremental effects and total campaign resources, no hypothetical amortization claimed as observed ROI.

selection: Exact complete task.py/input-generator, declared precision/mutability and profile, current independently observed runtime, same4approved original successes. Compact prompt and artifact action use identical selected source. No score ranking or learner.
stop_rules: One frozen comparison, no automatic model/job retries or further resampling in this study
No conditional confirmation unless protected practical benefit passes; retain all failures and costs
Prefer compact source prompting if explicit artifact proposal does not earn its extra machinery
limitations: Same4known operator formulas on new shapes/strides/seeds, not unseen operators, families, hardware or production evidence
Initial and independent final full remain; artifact spends one of4action slots, leaving at most3model decisions
Content hashes are integrity checks; approved manifests/trusted adapters are not OS sandboxes
No proof of general recursive capability improvement or superiority to original reference algorithms
